WITH fv AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id, valid_from,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS vn
  FROM dim_member)
SELECT join_date, COUNT(*) AS n_first_versions, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS n_members
FROM fv WHERE vn=1 AND join_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-20' AND DATE '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT m.member_key, m.member_id, m.join_date, m.tier, m.home_store_id, m.valid_from, m.valid_to, m.is_current,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_member x WHERE x.member_id=m.member_id) AS nver,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT x.join_date) FROM dim_member x WHERE x.member_id=m.member_id) AS njoin
FROM dim_member m
WHERE m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-09-25')
   OR m.valid_from = DATE '2026-09-25'
ORDER BY m.member_id, m.valid_from

SELECT max(join_date) AS max_join, max(valid_from) AS max_vf, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT member_key) AS dk,
 (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale,
 (SELECT max(period_end_date) FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fully_loaded) AS loaded_to
FROM dim_member

WITH fv AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id, valid_from,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS vn
  FROM dim_member)
SELECT
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fv WHERE vn=1 AND join_date = DATE '2026-09-25') AS new_members,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fv WHERE vn=1 AND valid_from = DATE '2026-09-25' AND join_date <> DATE '2026-09-25') AS vf_mismatch,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fv WHERE vn=1 AND join_date = DATE '2026-09-25' AND valid_from <> join_date) AS join_vf_mismatch,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fv WHERE vn=1 AND join_date = DATE '2026-09-25' AND home_store_id=900) AS online,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-09-25') AS all_rows,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fv WHERE vn=1 AND join_date = DATE '2026-09-25' AND home_store_id NOT IN (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store)) AS unknown_store
